# A Mosquito's Life Cycle — sources

Rules: skill atlas-space-topic (references/writing-rules.md) and skill industrial-3d-showcase references/fact-discipline.md. Numbers in chapter bodies are `<Num s="S#">`; part details cite `[S#]`. Design values and the simulated operating point are their own entry (the design study), with the arithmetic in the notes; they are not measurements. Reference images used for modelling are listed in the content spec, not here (they are not published).

- [S1] Atlas design study for this topic (a model, not a particular specimen; docs/33). Design values: the mosquitoes, eggs, larvae and pupa drawn 200 × life size (1 scene unit = 5 mm); a female Aedes aegypti 4.5 mm from the front of the head to the tip of the abdomen, the male drawn 0.85 of her size; the female's palps drawn about a fifth of the proboscis; eight visible abdominal segments; three stylets drawn for the bundle of six; a display dish 40 mm across holding water about 9 mm deep, with twelve eggs on its wall and the stages set round it in order; a ruler of 40 mm; the larvae drawn to the measured body lengths and head widths of S29; the pupa to the measurements of S23; the home corner drawn life size (floor tiles 55 cm). Simulated results (the life-cycle model, from the measured stage means of S16): hatching to adult 13.4, 10.2, 7.2 and 6.4 days at 20, 25, 28 and 32 °C; as a larva 9.3, 7.6, 5.4 and 4.7 days; as a pupa 4.1, 2.6, 1.9 and 1.7 days; at 28 °C the larval instars last 1.9, 0.7, 1.0 and 1.8 days and the stage on each day after hatching is larva 1 (days 0–1), larva 2 (day 2), larva 3 (day 3), larva 4 (days 4–5), pupa (days 6–7) and adult (day 8); the cycle runs at 0.54, 0.71, 1 and 1.13 times its speed at 28 °C; tipped out every 2, 4 or 6 days no adult comes out, every 8, 10 or 14 days some do; with the wall scrubbed no eggs are left on it. / 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（是模型，不对应某一只标本；docs/33）。设计值：蚊子、卵、孑孓和蛹都放大 200 倍画（1 个场景单位 = 5 毫米）；雌性埃及伊蚊从头前端到腹末长 4.5 毫米，雄蚊画成她的 0.85 倍；雌蚊的触须画成喙长的约五分之一；腹部画出八节；六根口针只画三根；展示用的浅皿直径 40 毫米，水深约 9 毫米，皿壁上画十二粒卵，各阶段按顺序绕皿排开；尺长 40 毫米；孑孓按 S29 测得的体长和头宽画，蛹按 S23 的测量画；家居一角按实物大小画（地砖边长 55 厘米）。模拟结果（生活史模型，由 S16 测得的各阶段平均天数推出）：水温 20、25、28、32 °C 时，孵化到成虫分别为 13.4、10.2、7.2、6.4 天；幼虫期 9.3、7.6、5.4、4.7 天；蛹期 4.1、2.6、1.9、1.7 天；28 °C 时四个龄期分别为 1.9、0.7、1.0、1.8 天，孵化后各天所在的阶段是：第 0–1 天一龄、第 2 天二龄、第 3 天三龄、第 4–5 天四龄、第 6–7 天蛹、第 8 天成虫；环转动的速度是 28 °C 时的 0.54、0.71、1、1.13 倍；每 2、4、6 天倒一次水，没有成虫出来，每 8、10、14 天倒一次，就有成虫出来；刷过壁，壁上就没有卵。 (Not a measurement. The day counts are worked out from one laboratory study of male mosquitoes (S16): each stage's mean is scaled so that the stages add up to the study's own mean from hatching to adult (13.40, 10.18, 7.23 and 6.40 days); a stage starts on the day its scaled boundary is reached. The emptying result compares the interval with that mean: if the water stays longer than it, some adults come out. This is a line drawn through averages, for one batch hatched together; real mosquitoes vary, females develop a little more slowly than males (S13), and food and crowding change the times too (S37). The head widths (S29) come from a different sample of larvae from the timed ones. The model's sizes, the palp ratio and the dish are drawing choices; measured sizes are in S16, S22, S23, S29 and S44. / 不是实测值。天数由一项雄蚊的实验室研究（S16）推出：把每个阶段的平均天数按比例缩放，使各阶段之和等于该研究自己测得的孵化到成虫的平均天数（13.40、10.18、7.23、6.40 天）；到了缩放后的分界那一天，就进入下一阶段。倒水的结果是把间隔和这个平均天数相比：积水留得比它久，就有成虫出来。这是按平均值、对一批同时孵化的孑孓画出的界线；真实的蚊子有快有慢，雌蚊比雄蚊发育得稍慢（S13），食物多少、孑孓密度也会改变天数（S37）。头宽（S29）来自另一批孑孓，不是被计时的那一批。模型里的大小、触须的比例和浅皿都是画法上的选择；实测的大小见 S16、S22、S23、S29 和 S44。)

- [S4] National Environment Agency (NEA), Aedes Mosquito (updated 13 April 2026): under optimal conditions eggs hatch in less than a day, larvae become pupae in about four days and adults come out about two days later; eggs can survive dry for up to about nine months; only females bite, needing the protein in blood for their eggs; eggs are laid about three days after a blood meal, about 100 at a time, about three times in a lifetime; adults live about two weeks on average in nature; a mosquito becomes infective about seven days after biting a person carrying the virus. / 国家环境局（环境局），《伊蚊》（2026 年 4 月 13 日更新）：在最适宜的条件下，卵不到一天孵化，幼虫约四天化蛹，再约两天羽化为成虫；卵能干着活长达约九个月；只有雌蚊叮人，她需要血里的蛋白质让卵发育；吸血后约三天产卵，每次约 100 粒，一生约三次；成虫在野外平均约活两周；蚊子叮了带病毒的人约七天后，就能传播病毒。 (Approximate public-health guidance: no temperature, strain or study is given, so it is set beside the laboratory figures of S16 and S21, not combined with them. / 这是大约的公共卫生指引，没有写温度、品系或研究出处，所以和 S16、S21 的实验室数字并列，不合在一起算。) — https://www.nea.gov.sg/dengue-zika/prevent-aedes-mosquito-breeding/aedes-mosquito

## How the sources were read

- All pages were read on 2026-10-19 (research and a second fact-check pass by Codex, `art/codex-research/mosquito/`, `art/codex-drafts/mosquito/facts-pass2.*`; every number used here was checked against those records during the build).
- Numbers are kept to the slots of the content spec (docs/33 §6.2, P# = S#). Slots S8, S39, S40, S47 and S56 are left empty: S8 (Wolbachia programme page) and S47 (a second head-width study) were read but not needed; S39 (Lianhe Zaobao articles as evidence for Singapore Chinese terms: 伊蚊, 埃及伊蚊, 白纹伊蚊, 孑孓, 骨痛热症, 沃尔巴克氏菌) and S40 (education research behind the misconceptions list) informed the writing but are not cited; S56 (an approximate 8 mm for the fourth instar) was replaced by the measured lengths of S29.
- Abstract only: S49, S50, S55. The NEA bilingual leaflet (S6) is an image; its Chinese wording was read from the page.

## Not used, and why

- “Mosquitoes are not born carrying the virus”: WHO records transmission from a female to her eggs, so the topic says only that a female picks up the virus from an infected person and that only an infected mosquito can spread dengue.
- “Dengue never passes directly between people”: WHO records rare routes (mother to baby, blood products, transplants); the topic says only that it is not spread by everyday contact.
- UF's 100–200 eggs per batch and up to five batches (S13): primary measurements not found; NEA's about 100, about three times (S4) are used.
- Service's 3–6 mm for mosquitoes in general and its count of ten abdominal segments (S14): not species measurements; the model's 4.5 mm and eight segments are drawing choices (S1), measured lengths are S44.
- Project Wolbachia covering half of Singapore's households: a target for the end of 2026 at the time of reading (S11).
- How long the climb out of the pupal skin takes: not found (S50 gives only that new adults leave the water within minutes).
- A female development series under the same conditions as S16: not found; the model uses the male data and says so.

## Reference images

The geometry was drawn from the descriptions and measurements above (S13, S14, S17, S21, S22, S23, S29, S52, S53, S57) and the topic's reviewed figures; no photographs were downloaded for this build (docs/33 §9.2).
